import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

models=['mistralai/mistral-large-4-1t-a52b','meta/llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct','ibm/granite-3.0-8b-instruct']
commands=[['bash','scripts/with_resource.sh','nim','.venv/bin/python','-u','scripts/expand_nim.py',
           '--models',*models,'--protocol-file','protocol-additional.json'],
          ['bash','scripts/with_resource.sh','nim','.venv/bin/python','-u','scripts/expand_nim.py',
           '--models','openai/gpt-oss-20b','--protocol-file','protocol-gpt-resume2.json']]
path=Path('results/expansion/additional_followup_plan.json')
gpt=Path('results/expansion/raw/cards/openai_gpt-oss-20b.jsonl')
prefix=gpt.read_bytes()
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'probe additional listed models, evaluate usable candidates, then resume GPT-OSS missing cards'},'NIM immutable deployment revision not exposed'),
        'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'commands':commands,'status':'queued',
        'model_licence_verification':'results/licenses_nim_followup_20261030.json',
        'catalogue_sha256':file_sha256('results/expansion/models_20261030.json'),
        'gpt_existing_prefix_sha256':file_sha256(gpt),'gpt_existing_prefix_bytes':len(prefix),
        'mistral_api_options_source':'https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/mistralai-mistral-large-4-1t-a52b-infer',
        'mistral_decoder':'reasoning_effort=none; the hosted schema accepts none/high, unlike the vendor low/medium/high examples. Fixed before evaluation.',
        'sampling':'200/game, seeds 200-399, temperature 0.3, max_tokens 4096, timeout 600 seconds; client concurrency 1 under the shared NIM mutex.',
        'statistical_scope':'No held-out score has selected these models or decoders. No partial cohort score. Successful cached responses and completed episodes are reused exactly.'}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
for command in commands:
    record.update(status='acquiring_slot_then_running',current_command=command)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
    result=subprocess.run(command)
    record.setdefault('completed_commands',[]).append({'command':command,'exit_code':result.returncode})
    path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
assert gpt.read_bytes().startswith(prefix)
record.update(status='finished',gpt_prefix_preserved=True)
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
decoder: Mistral Large 4 uses the NIM-documented reasoning_effort=none. Text-only Llama90 and Granite8 use default chat settings; all 0.3 temperature/4096 tokens/600s/200 episodes per game on 200-399. Global NIM slots, own concurrency one. No scores inspected.
